# Routing_Color_Bits

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Per-node routing resources (e.g., virtual channels or color bits) that allow multiple logical graphs to be multiplexed over the same physical links. Enables flexible virtual topologies on fixed physical wiring, a key mechanism for adapting TCC fabrics to diverse workloads.
